name: Hondarribia (Spain)
description: White field with a red saltire, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Hondarribia (a castle and a ship above waves within a red inscribed bordure, surmounted by a figure of the Virgin).
history: Municipal flag of Hondarribia; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
